seo.title: Ahabanza
seo.description: Pi Global GCV Alliance — ihuriro ry'ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga rihuza Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika binyuze mu bucuruzi, ubuhanga bushya, no guteza imbere ubukungu rusange. Ishyura muri Pi ku giciro cyagenwe n'umuryango (GCV target).

hero.subtitle: Ihuriro mpuzamahanga rihuza Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika binyuze mu bucuruzi, ubuhanga bushya, no guteza imbere ubukungu rusange.

gcvTarget.label: Igiciro Rusange cya GCV
gcvTarget.disclaimer: Ntabwo ari igiciro cya Pi Network cyemewe cyangwa igiciro cyo kuvunja.

payInPi.title: Ishyura muri Pi
payInPi.desc: Kwishyura byoroshye ku giciro rusange cya GCV

founder.badge: Umuyobozi Mushingamurwa, Pi Global GCV Alliance
founder.name: Olivier Ndatimana
founder.quote: Atuye i Kigali, mu Rwanda, Olivier ayoboye intego y'Ihuriro yo guhuza abacuruzi, abikorera n'ibigo hirya no hino muri Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika munsi y'urwego rumwe rw'ubucuruzi n'igiciro rusange.
founder.bio: Nk'Umuyobozi Mukuru wa Kigali Hot Market Ltd, intego ya Olivier ni ugutuma buri wese ugize uruhare mu isoko — kuva ku barimyi bato kugeza ku bigo bitanga serivisi — abona uburyo bwiza kandi butaziguye bwo kwinjira mu mushinga w'ubucuruzi mpuzamahanga ukura buri munsi.

mission.heading: Intego n'Icyerekezo
mission.missionText: Guhuza abacuruzi, abatanga serivisi, n'ibigo biri muri Afurika, Uburayi, Aziya na Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika munsi y'ihuriro rimwe ry'ubucuruzi — dushyigikira buri munyamuryango kugira uburenganzira bungana bwo kwinjira mu isoko, ibiciro binyuze mu buryo bwuzuye kandi bishobora kwishyurwa muri Pi ku giciro rusange cya GCV.
mission.visionText: Isoko mpuzamahanga aho ubucuruzi butemba mu bwisanzure hagati y'imigabane — bushyigikira ubuhinzi, inganda, serivisi z'umwuga, n'ubucuruzi ku banyamuryango bose b'Ihuriro, ku giciro kimwe gihamye cy'igiciro rusange cya GCV cya 1 π ≈ ${{value}}.

membership.heading: Ba Umunyamuryango
membership.text: Pi Global GCV Alliance ifunguriwe buri mucuruzi, ikigo n'urwego rwose. Niba ushaka kuba Intumwa (Ambassador), kwandikisha ikigo cyawe nk'Umucuruzi wa GCV, cyangwa gusa kwinjira mu muryango — hari uruhare rwakugendera.

member.title: Umunyamuryango wa GCV
member.desc: Injira mu muryango utangire gushakisha ku Isoko rya GCV.

merchant.title: Umucuruzi wa GCV
merchant.desc: Andikisha ikigo cyawe kugira ngo cyakire Pi ku giciro rusange cya GCV.

ambassador.title: Intumwa ya GCV
ambassador.desc: Yobora umuvuvuzi mu gihugu cyawe cyangwa akarere kawe.

cta.heading: Injira muri Pi Global GCV Alliance Uyu Munsi!
cta.subtitle: Ba umwe mu muvuvuzi mpuzamahanga ubaka ubukungu binyuze mu bucuruzi n'ubumwe.
